# Snowball (SNBL)

> Pool-integrated staircase meme token on BNB Chain for Binance Agent ID
> holders. Pool opens with the first buyer; 80% of every payment enters
> the PancakeSwap pool in the same transaction (LP burned); price climbs
> +10% every 10 of 10,000 shares; first share per wallet is 90% off
> (paid, not free); referral 1 bonus share per 10; pair tax buy 1% /
> sell 2%; zero owner allocation; no admin functions; no end date.
